name: Rho
description:
Rho is the modern banking platform for fast-moving companies. Banking, cards, and treasury from day one, with invoicing, bill pay, and expenses as you grow. 

The Rho MCP connector brings your Rho account and transaction data directly into Claude, so you can query, analyze, and act on your finances without leaving your AI workflow.

Built for founders and operators who want to build AI-powered workflows on top of real business financial data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rho to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rho to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://rhoapi.rho.co/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rho MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rho provides these MCP tools: getAccount, getStatement, getTransaction, listAccounts, listStatements, and listTransactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rho?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Rho in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Rho requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rho is developed by Rho. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
